safe.title: Calm Trade Winds
safe.description: The route stays clean, the cargo stays dry, and a grateful merchant pays the crew.

safe.title: Driftwood Cache
safe.description: A sealed crate bumps the hull. Inside: enough Beri to make the watch cheer.

safe.title: Quiet Horizon
safe.description: No treasure, no trouble. Sometimes the sea's mercy is the reward.

risky.title: Black Market Tip
risky.description: A shady broker buys your rumor before the Marines catch wind of it.

risky.title: Sunken Strongbox
risky.description: You dive through wreckage and come up coughing seawater around a grin.

risky.title: Reef Tax
risky.description: A bad current eats supplies, patches, and pride before you break free.

risky.title: Marine Checkpoint
risky.description: You escape the inspection, but the bribe pouch comes back light.
